task.prompt:

1. Between Saturday, September 14, 2002 and Wednesday, November 27, 2002 (counting both dates), how many times does Wednesday occur? Respond with just the number.
2. Between Tuesday, April 9, 2002 and Tuesday, June 11, 2002 (counting both dates), what's the total count of business days (Monday through Friday)? Write the total number.
3. Between Saturday, April 13, 2002 and Wednesday, October 23, 2002 (counting both dates), how many times does Saturday occur? Provide the count as a number.
4. Count the occurrences of Tuesday from Tuesday, September 17 to Friday, October 18, 2002 (including both start and end dates). Give the count numerically.
5. How many Fridays are there from Wednesday, November 27, 2002 to Friday, December 6, 2002 (inclusive of both dates)? Respond with just the number.
6. Between Friday, December 6, 2002 and Wednesday, December 11, 2002 (counting both dates), how many times does Tuesday occur? Write the total number.
7. How many business days (Monday-Friday) are there from Saturday, May 4, 2002 to Monday, August 26, 2002 (inclusive of both dates)? Provide the count as a number.
8. How many Saturdays are there from Sunday, March 24, 2002 to Thursday, July 25, 2002 (inclusive of both dates)? Write the total number.
9. How many Tuesdays are there from Saturday, March 2, 2002 to Wednesday, June 26, 2002 (inclusive of both dates)? Provide the count as a number.
10. How many Saturdays are there from Friday, March 22, 2002 to Friday, September 20, 2002 (inclusive of both dates)? Express your answer as a number.
11. Between Friday, September 27, 2002 and Monday, November 18, 2002 (counting both dates), how many times does Thursday occur? Answer with a number.
12. Between Monday, May 6, 2002 and Sunday, September 22, 2002 (counting both dates), how many times does Tuesday occur? Give the count numerically.
13. How many business days (Monday-Friday) are there from Saturday, January 19, 2002 to Sunday, May 26, 2002 (inclusive of both dates)? State the amount as a number.
14. Count the occurrences of Monday from Saturday, May 18 to Tuesday, October 8, 2002 (including both start and end dates). Give the count numerically.
15. Count the occurrences of Thursday from Friday, July 5 to Sunday, November 24, 2002 (including both start and end dates). Give the count numerically.

20. Count the weekdays (excluding weekends) from Saturday, August 24 to Saturday, October 26, 2002 (including both start and end dates). Give the count numerically.
21. How many Saturdays are there from Monday, September 9, 2002 to Sunday, September 15, 2002 (inclusive of both dates)? State the amount as a number.

25. Count the occurrences of Thursday from Saturday, October 5 to Wednesday, November 13, 2002 (including both start and end dates). Give the count numerically.
26. How many Fridays are there from Wednesday, September 11, 2002 to Thursday, December 26, 2002 (inclusive of both dates)? Write the total number.
27. Count the occurrences of Wednesday from Tuesday, March 26 to Saturday, April 13, 2002 (including both start and end dates). Express your answer as a number.
28. Count the occurrences of Saturday from Friday, June 28 to Friday, September 13, 2002 (including both start and end dates). Answer with a number.
29. Between Friday, May 10, 2002 and Friday, October 11, 2002 (counting both dates), what's the total count of business days (Monday through Friday)? Give the count numerically.
30. Between Wednesday, July 3, 2002 and Sunday, October 6, 2002 (counting both dates), how many times does Friday occur? Express your answer as a number.
31. How many business days (Monday-Friday) are there from Thursday, July 18, 2002 to Sunday, September 1, 2002 (inclusive of both dates)? Express your answer as a number.
32. Count the occurrences of Thursday from Friday, May 24 to Tuesday, July 30, 2002 (including both start and end dates). State the amount as a number.
33. Between Wednesday, April 24, 2002 and Saturday, August 10, 2002 (counting both dates), how many times does Wednesday occur? Answer with a number.
34. Count the occurrences of Friday from Tuesday, October 29 to Thursday, November 14, 2002 (including both start and end dates). Answer with a number.
35. Between Saturday, January 5, 2002 and Wednesday, April 10, 2002 (counting both dates), how many times does Sunday occur? Write the total number.
36. Between Wednesday, September 18, 2002 and Tuesday, December 31, 2002 (counting both dates), how many times does Sunday occur? Express your answer as a number.
37. How many business days (Monday-Friday) are there from Saturday, May 25, 2002 to Monday, July 1, 2002 (inclusive of both dates)? Give the count numerically.
38. Count the weekdays (excluding weekends) from Thursday, July 25 to Wednesday, August 14, 2002 (including both start and end dates). Express your answer as a number.
39. Between Thursday, April 18, 2002 and Thursday, October 3, 2002 (counting both dates), how many times does Sunday occur? Give the count numerically.
40. Count the occurrences of Wednesday from Tuesday, March 19 to Friday, May 3, 2002 (including both start and end dates). Answer with a number.
41. Count the weekdays (excluding weekends) from Sunday, September 15 to Tuesday, October 8, 2002 (including both start and end dates). Respond with just the number.
42. How many Saturdays are there from Sunday, December 22, 2002 to Tuesday, December 31, 2002 (inclusive of both dates)? State the amount as a number.
43. How many Fridays are there from Sunday, October 27, 2002 to Tuesday, November 19, 2002 (inclusive of both dates)? Give the count numerically.
44. Count the weekdays (excluding weekends) from Monday, May 13 to Wednesday, July 31, 2002 (including both start and end dates). Express your answer as a number.
45. Count the occurrences of Sunday from Wednesday, April 10 to Sunday, June 23, 2002 (including both start and end dates). Reply with the numerical value.
46. Between Sunday, February 10, 2002 and Wednesday, February 27, 2002 (counting both dates), how many times does Thursday occur? Reply with the numerical value.
47. Count the occurrences of Thursday from Thursday, March 21 to Thursday, March 28, 2002 (including both start and end dates). Provide the count as a number.
48. How many Sundays are there from Monday, July 1, 2002 to Wednesday, October 2, 2002 (inclusive of both dates)? Provide the count as a number.
49. Between Wednesday, August 7, 2002 and Tuesday, November 19, 2002 (counting both dates), what's the total count of business days (Monday through Friday)? State the amount as a number.
50. How many Mondays are there from Tuesday, April 9, 2002 to Tuesday, May 28, 2002 (inclusive of both dates)? Write the total number.

Give the final answer as a comma-separated list of 50 integers, one per question in order.

Think it through, then finish with a final line of the form `ANSWER: <your answer>`.
